cues.en: And Purdue's overall message of a quick, easy cure for pain was very appealing, especially for primary care doctors who might only have fifteen minutes to treat a patient. So it is no wonder that by the year 2000, doctors were writing nearly 6,000,000
cues.zh: Purdue 关于快速、轻松治愈疼痛的宣传非常有吸引力，尤其是对那些每次只有十五分钟给患者看病的全科医生来说。所以，到了 2000 年，医生们每年开出的 OxyContin

cues.en: However, evidence started piling up that it was far riskier than promised with headlines like OxyContin abuse is increasing and OxyContin abuse called a plague or as I'm sure Purdue would call it, a pseudo plague.

cues.zh: 要是我没断医保，就像我说的，要是我每个月去信箱还能拿到一瓶 OxyContin，我很可能现在还在吃，也很可能已经没命了。

cues.zh: 想想看，断了医保竟然可能救了她一命。这讽刺意味之深，足以把 Alanis Morissette 直接蒸发成一团蒸汽。

cues.en: And and look, it wasn't just Purdue pushing the envelope. Cephalon paid a $444,000,000
cues.zh: 而且你看，毫无底线的可不只有 Purdue。Cephalon 支付了 4.44 亿美元

cues.en: settlement for over marketing drugs, and Insys has been investigated for some of its practices surrounding a drug they made containing fentanyl,
cues.zh: 的和解金，原因同样是过度营销药物；而 Insys 也因其生产的一款含芬太尼药物的相关操作遭到了调查，

cues.en: an opioid which can be a 100 times more powerful than morphine. Their drug is only approved for cancer patients, but Incis is accused of not just pushing it for non cancer patients, but even helping convince insurance companies to pay for it. And to do that, according to one ex employee, they used a particularly shady technique.
cues.zh: 这种阿片类药物的效力可达吗啡的 100 倍。他们的药原本只批准用于癌症患者，但 Insys 被指控不仅将其推销给非癌症患者，甚至还协助说服保险公司为此买单。据一位前员工称，为了做到这一点，他们采用了一种极其下作的手段。

cues.zh: 母公司告诉我们，那些做法都已是过去式了，而 Insys 否认有任何不当行为，并且没有回应我们的任何问题，甚至连一句“才没有”都没回。

cues.en: But at a certain point, the question has to become less, what did we do wrong, and more, what do we do now? Because these drugs are still the most effective solution for certain types of pain, and many patients need them, so we can't get rid of them. But we have to be much more careful about how they're prescribed. And to their credit, the CDC issued voluntary guidelines this year suggesting doctors use non opioid therapies when possible and, if and when one is needed, to start patients with a lower dose and a shorter supply, a technique that they call start low and go slow, which does sound good, but also sounds like how your creepiest high school friends described cunnilingus.
cues.zh: 但在某个节点上，问题就不能只是“我们做错了什么”，而更多应该是“我们现在该怎么做”。因为对于某些类型的疼痛，这些药物依然是最有效的解决方案，很多患者也确实需要它们，所以我们不能因噎废食。但我们在开具处方时必须谨慎得多。值得肯定的是，CDC 今年发布了一份自愿性指南，建议医生尽可能使用非阿片类疗法；如果确实需要使用，也要从小剂量和短疗程开始，他们将这种做法称为“低量起步、缓步推进（start low and go slow）”——听起来确实挺好，但也挺像你高中时最猥琐的哥们儿用来描述舔阴的说法。

cues.zh: 听着。虽然这一切听起来很棒，但不幸的是，

cues.zh: 并非全国所有地区都能获得替代性疼痛治疗。

cues.en: It's easy to say use some non opioid alternative,
cues.zh: 说用些非阿片类替代疗法很容易，

cues.zh: 但在许多农村地区，患者无法获得物理治疗和正念冥想之类的东西，

cues.en: and insurance companies won't pay for it. And that is a big problem, because even in a rural area, alternative pain treatments should be at least as easy to find as waffle houses, which, like heroin, are both hazardous to your health and dangerously addictive.
cues.zh: 而且保险公司不会报销。这是个很大的问题，因为即使在农村地区，替代性疼痛治疗至少也应该像找 Waffle House 一样容易，而 Waffle House 和海洛因一样，既危害健康又极易上瘾。

cues.en: And and to put it mildly, it does not seem that the pharmaceutical industry is expecting any major reversals in opioid sales anytime soon. In fact, they are now marketing extra drugs to fight one of opioid side effects, constipation.
cues.zh: 而且而且说得客气点，制药行业似乎并不认为阿片类药物销售短期内会有任何重大逆转。事实上，他们现在正在推销额外药物，来对抗阿片类药物的副作用之一：便秘。

cues.en: If you need an opioid to manage your chronic pain, you may be so constipated.
cues.zh: 如果你需要阿片类药物来控制慢性疼痛，你可能会便秘得很厉害。

cues.en: It feels like everyone can go except you.

cues.zh: 而那则广告

cues.en: to prevent future addicts. We're going to need to do more to help the millions that already exist, which means more investment in treatment programs as well as increasing the availability of drugs like

From the chief down, we tend to have more overdoses than we do Fire. Fires. So it's a piece of equipment that we can't go without now, just like we have the hose.

cues.en: there is no one simple answer here. Not all opioid addicts will respond to the same treatment, and not all people in pain will find relief from alternative therapies. This is going to take a massive effort and a significant investment. It won't be cheap, it won't be quick and it won't be easy. And it is hard not to be angry at the drug companies like Purdue, whose promise of cheap, quick, easy pain solutions helped put us in this fucking mess. Because while they may not be solely responsible,
cues.zh: 这里根本没有万灵药。并非所有阿片类成瘾者都对同一种疗法有效，也并非所有饱受疼痛折磨的人都能通过替代疗法得到缓解。这需要巨大的努力和可观的投入。它不会便宜，不会迅速，也绝不容易。而面对像 Purdue 这样的制药公司，我们很难不愤怒，正是他们承诺的那种廉价、快速、简便的止痛方案，把我们推进了这该死的烂摊子。虽然他们可能并非唯一的责任方，

cues.en: if you were to ask me if they bear significant blame for reckless,
cues.zh: 但如果你问我，他们是否要为那种鲁莽、

cues.zh: 贪婪，并助长了这场严重公共卫生危机的行为承担重大责任，我或许不会斩钉截铁地说“是的”，
